status.en: 72 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 31% more than the week before, most of them in Sanaa, Mokha and Marib.
status.nb: 72 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 31 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Sanaa, Mokha og Marib.

summary.en: In the past week 77 armed incidents were reported, 43% more than the previous week, mainly in Sanaa, Mokha and Marib, and 18 were covered by two or more outlets. The UCDP recorded 918 battle‑related deaths in 2024. A missile attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport killed 12 people and injured around 300, prompting the airport’s suspension of operations. The UN Security Council warned that Yemen has fallen back into full‑scale war. Houthi forces continue striking Saudi targets as fighting intensifies.
summary.nb: I løpet av den siste uken ble 77 væpnede hendelser rapportert, 43 % flere enn uken før, hovedsakelig i Sanaa, Mokha og Marib, og 18 ble dekket av to eller flere kilder. UCDP registrerte 918 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024. Et missilangrep på Riyadhs King Khalid International Airport drepte 12 personer og såret rundt 300, noe som førte til at flyplassen stengte driften. FN‑sikkerhetsrådet advarte om at Jemen har falt tilbake i fullskala krig. Houthi‑styrker fortsetter å angripe saudiarabiske mål mens kampene intensiveres.

background.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
background.extract: The Yemeni civil war is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.
